get.summary: Build version of the running API (used by deploy smoke tests).

post.summary: Sign in with mobile number and 6-digit PIN.
Exchange the refresh cookie for a new access token (the cookie rotates).
End this session chain on the server and clear the cookie.
Replace your PIN (required after a temporary PIN). Other devices are signed out.

get.summary: Current user, organization, and accessible funds with permissions.
Funds the caller can open (Admins: all; Members: assigned Active/Closed).

post.summary: Create a user. The response contains a one-time temporary PIN.

patch.summary: Activate or deactivate. Deactivation signs the user out everywhere immediately.

put.summary: Replace a Member's fund access list (PRD /users/{id}/permissions).

post.summary: Issue a new temporary PIN (shown once) and sign the user out everywhere.
Sign the user out of one session (familyId) or all sessions.

get.summary: All funds with type, status and balance (Admin).

post.summary: Close a fund: no new transactions until reopened.

put.summary: Set opening balances per account (Admin; a reason is required on an active fund).

get.summary: Categories for a direction and fund (org-wide plus fund-specific).

post.summary: Move money between two accounts of one fund.

get.summary: Ledger with search, filters, sort, totals and cursor paging.
One entry, with what the caller may do with it. ETag is the revision.

put.summary: Edit an entry. Needs If-Match with the revision being edited; Admin edits need a reason.

post.summary: Cancel an entry (Admin). It stays in history and leaves the balances.

get.summary: Who changed what, when and why (newest first).
Computed balance of every account within one fund.

post.summary: Record a correction to an account balance (Admin only; reason required).

get.summary: CSV of the filtered log (max 5,000 rows). The export is itself audited.
The ten reports (TRD §10.1). Who may open them is decided per fund (can_view_reports).
Run one report for a fund and period. Members without 'see all' get their own entries only.

post.summary: Start an export (CSV, XLSX or PDF). Needs an Idempotency-Key header; a repeat returns the same job.

get.summary: Status of one of the caller's exports.
Money In receipt (PDF). Money In entries only; same access as the entry itself.

put.summary: Save the organization profile and settings. Changes are audited.
